english.title: Act as a member of the crew of an aircraft while under influence of a drug
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) on **(..SPECIFY FLIGHT NUMBER AND DEPARTURE AND DESTINATION AIRPORTS WHERE APPROPRIATE..), when acting as a member of the crew of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY TYPE OF AIRCRAFT..), you were under the influence of a drug, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DRUG..), to such an extent as to impair your capacity so to act
english.legislation: Contrary to Articles 139(2) and 241(7) of, and Part C of Schedule 13 to the Air Navigation Order 2009 made under sections 60 and 61 of the Civil Aviation Act 1982.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
acting as member of crew on an aircraft
was under the influence of a drug to such an extent as to impair capacity so to act

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Articles 247 and 248 respectively of this Order for details of the extra-territorial effect of the Order when the aircraft is UK registered or when it is foreign registered but over UK territorial waters.
(ii) See the Civil Aviation (Amendment) Act 1996, which amends Section 92 of the Civil Aviation Act 1982, for when the aircraft on which the offence is committed is foreign registered and over foreign territorial waters.
(iii) Breath test procedure under section 6 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 applies as modified by section 96 of the Railways and Transport Safety Act 2003.
